title: Define restart-risk treatment for an unbound test task completed with an Unknown verdict
outcome: An explicitly completed test task with no Engram work binding has a documented, truthful restart-risk and history-retention treatment even when its native test verdict remains Unknown, without inventing a verification or native PASS.
acceptance: The design distinguishes positive absence of a work/report binding from an unknown native test result and specifies whether a completed unbound Unknown row must remain in unresolved backlog; the chosen behavior is documented with evidence limits.

Production-path controls cover durable and failed/pending observation persistence plus completed Unknown versus genuinely live unbound rows, without minting Passed/Failed-style proof or dropping unresolved bound evidence.
